notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3 - 06-22-2020
notes.content:
Hello!
Today we have for you a patch that improves the performance of few objects and fixes possible glitches of wall tilesets on higher zooms.

Changes made in patch 1.0.3:

changes to wall tilesets,
impromevent to fan performance,
improvement to flamethrowers performance,
bug fix that caused doors to get stuck sometimes,
added functionality to allow players to switch between all, local and Steam Workshop levels in the Custom level selection screen.


Have fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1 - 02.02.2020
notes.content:
Hello!
Today we have for you a small update:
fixed a bug that could crash the game after rewinding,
added descriptions to the animated keys/buttons of the tutorial in the first levels,
speed up the showing of descriptions of buttons on the screen after player's death.
